gate: Lightning is the closest natural image for what this code does in a person. A sudden break in the ordinary current, after which the room is not the same room. The drive carries the body's capacity to take a shock and stay standing, and more than that, to use the shock as a door. The misread is to call this bravado, the swagger of someone who likes the edge. It is not. The pull is older and quieter. A part of the body knows the only way some thresholds get crossed is by force, by an event that rearranges the ground under a person without their permission. This code is the willingness to be that event for others, and the willingness to be on the receiving end when life arranges it that way. Either side of the lightning, the work is the same. Stay upright. Let the strike clean what it cleans.
centre_field: Where this drive lives is the part of you that backs a promise with a body. It is small and concentrated, the engine that turns I said I would into I did. Shock is wired here on purpose. The strike has to be backed by something or it is only noise, a loud event with no follow-through. This wiring is what lets the code endure its own lightning, and what makes the code carry weight when it lands in another person. There is a body behind the disruption, a steadiness that says the break is survivable because the one delivering it has already survived it. Capacity is the ground the shock stands on. Without it, the lightning has no one home to receive it and no one home to send it. With it, the strike is grounded in a will that can take what it dishes out.
channel: By itself, this code can break the surface but cannot say what the breaking is for. The strike lands, the ground shifts, and then what. There is no inner compass in the shock alone, no read on whether the disruption served anything or was simply destructive. The reach is across the body, toward the still place in you that loves what is and holds the spirit of who you are. The old name for that joining is the line of initiation. Without the still place, the shock is only violence. Without the shock, the stillness is contemplation that never gets tested. Joined, the disruption is aimed by a steady heart, a break that has somewhere to deliver the broken to. Alone, this code is a hammer with no target. Together, it becomes the rite that breaks a person open into a wider life. The lightning needs the still place to land in.
